scores.rationale: The plan is a component catalogue with no phases, so there is no dependency ordering of build steps.
No Phase 0 or thin end-to-end production slice is defined; the plan describes the full architecture at once.
Irreversible choices (tenancy model, Kafka, Timescale, gateway) are asserted without defaults and flip conditions; the one hedge has no trigger.
There is no work ordering within phases, and nothing sequences widest-impact work ahead of leaf work.

scores.evidence: Row-Level Security (RLS) ... Webhook Signature Verification HMAC-SHA256 with tenant-specific secret
scores.rationale: Security content is substantial but sits in standalone sections, not threaded through phases.

scores.evidence: Prometheus metrics, ELK Stack for logging, Jaeger for distributed tracing
scores.rationale: Observability tools are listed in the deployment section only, with no day-zero or per-phase treatment.

scores.evidence: Build Docker Image → Deploy to Staging → Canary Deployment
scores.rationale: A CI/CD pipeline and Kubernetes are mentioned, but reproducibility (IaC, pinned builds, data and env parity) is not addressed and nothing is phased.

scores.evidence: Chaos Testing: Database failure simulation, Payment gateway timeout, Kafka broker failure
scores.rationale: Idempotency, retries and chaos tests appear, but as standalone items rather than threaded across phases.
The plan never says whether an AI layer applies, so the N/A declaration is missing.
There is no list of deferred work and no pull-forward conditions.

note: The plan is a broad component and schema catalogue with no phasing, decision gates or deferral list, so it scores low on the ordering dimensions; only security, observability and resilience get partial credit.
